u0: This is the opening stage before any relevant progress: the blocking ball has not been moved away, the matching key has not been taken, and the target box has not been picked up. You may acquire the key first, which settles the requirement that the key be taken before the box, or move the ball first, which creates an obligation to take the key later. The mission still requires opening the way to the other room and picking up the designated box; picking up that box before any key has been taken would fail the task. Waiting or repositioning without changing these conditions leaves you here.
u1: The target box was picked up before the matching key had been taken, so the mandatory key-before-box ordering was violated. If the blocking ball had already been moved, this also means the required key acquisition for that movement never happened. Successful completion is no longer possible from this failure stage.
u2: The matching key has been acquired at some point while the blocking ball remained in place, so the requirement to take the key before the box is already satisfied and any later movement of the ball will not leave the key requirement unmet. The ball still blocks the door, the door has not been opened, and the target box has not been picked up. The remaining objective is to get through the door and pick up the designated box; if the key has been dropped and the door is still closed, it must be retrieved again first. Moving the ball from here preserves the key requirement and advances toward the box, and picking up the box completes the task.
u3: The designated target box has been picked up, which is the mission's completion condition. The matching key had been taken before this pickup, and any earlier movement of the blocking ball has been followed by the box pickup. All mandatory requirements are therefore satisfied, and the episode ends successfully with no further action required.
u4: The blocking ball has already been moved away from the door at least once, but the matching key has not yet been taken. This leaves a mandatory key requirement outstanding: the matching key must be acquired before the target box is picked up. Picking up the target now without the key would fail the task, while acquiring the key next satisfies that obligation and leaves the box as the remaining goal. The ball may later be returned to the doorway, but the fact that it was moved remains relevant.
u5: The blocking ball has been moved and the matching key has been taken at some point, so the requirement that moving the ball be accompanied by taking the key and the requirement that the key be taken before the box are already satisfied. Even if the ball is later returned to the doorway or the key is dropped, that history still counts; if the door has not yet been opened and the key is no longer held, the key must be retrieved again. The target box is the only remaining goal, and picking it up completes the task.
